result:
Created three self-contained JUnit 3.8 test classes (matching the project's existing JUnit version and Java 8 source level):

- `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli2/WriteableCommandLineAgentTest.java` — exercises the `WriteableCommandLine` interface contract (add/get values, switches, properties, defaults, `looksLikeOption`, current option) via `WriteableCommandLineImpl`.
- `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli2/commandline/WriteableCommandLineImplAgentTest.java` — covers impl-specific behavior: parent-chain propagation in `addOption`, default-value augmentation/override logic, switch fallback order, duplicate-switch exception, `toString` quoting, unmodifiable `getOptions`/`getNormalised`, and the reentrant-guard in `looksLikeOption` (via a custom probe `Option`).
- `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli2/option/GroupImplAgentTest.java` — covers `GroupImpl` construction (argument/option separation, parent wiring), `canProcess`/`findOption`/`process`/`validate` boundary cases (missing/too-many/required-child errors), `isRequired` edge cases, `appendUsage` variants, `helpLines`, and `defaults`.

All 55 assertions across the three files pass via `./_tools/test.sh`, and no other files were modified.
